description: The top of the guide: the glowing PLATINUM ROAD masthead sign over its sunset band, the neon road progress bar part-driven, the full dash-panel control row (search, kind, grade and earned filters, spoiler shield, export and import), and the first mile-marker trophy cards with several already stamped earned and their guide lines showing.

The six-stage roadmap rendered as green highway exit signs, from the opening story miles through character strands, collectibles and the activity grind to the final mile, each sign carrying its trophy chips and its own earned-progress readout.

A trophy detail view open on The Shootist, a silver trophy, showing the official description, its kind and grade, the practical guide in our own words, the sources line, and its gold-medal target counter part-filled at 27 of 42.

The spoiler shield switched on in the dash panel: unearned story trophies in the checklist are masked behind spoiler blocks so their names and descriptions stay hidden, while the shield toggle itself sits visibly on in the control row.
